svg.text: Jenkins CI · GitLeaks / OWASP / SonarQube / Trivy · Docker Hub · GitOps · Argo CD · Amazon EKS
— Jenkins declarative pipeline · 16 stages · Windows agent

GitLeaks, OWASP Dependency-Check and Trivy run as local CLI tools on the agent. Any security gate that reports a finding — or a failed SonarQube Quality Gate — aborts the build before an image is ever published.
stage 16 commits the new tag as jenkins-ci and pushes to main
— the CI job holds no cluster credentials; it only changes Git
every deploy is an auditable commit
applies the manifests to namespace prod
— AWS ap-south-1 · account 510720290879 · provisioned by Terraform (eks/*.tf)
VPC vpc-053cbf0227d0386c6 · 10.0.0.0/16 · DNS hostnames + DNS support
EKS devsecops-eks · k8s 1.36 · node group devsecops-nodes · 4 × t3.small · 10.0.11.0/24, 10.0.12.0/24
security gate — a finding fails the stage and stops the build
Prometheus and Grafana were installed on the cluster with Helm and are not tracked in this repository.
